status: DRAFT - not approved by Gary, NOT wired into game code
palette: art/world/overworld/palette.hex (64 colours) + full transparency; alpha is 0 or 255 only
scale_rule: draw 1x frames scaled by an integer (2x/3x) with nearest-neighbour only; *_2x files are exact nearest copies
sheet_layout: horizontal strip; frame i rect = [i*w, 0, w, h] (rects[] lists them)
emissive_rule: emissive 'all' -> grade with grades.<g>.lit (lut_<g>_lit.png); 'none' -> grades.<g>.sprite; 'mask' -> per pixel by <name>_emissive_sheet.png. Draw order: palette swaps -> grade.
about: Heal-centre restore FX (SOUL_PLAYBOOK heal beat, Kilumen style): one cradle ring round the machine eye, the whole team's crystals float in together, one scanner sweep, a single company-violet glow, a done ping, then each creature's Warmth seeps back in ordered dither.

sequence: healer (in-world role: Care Associate, NPC id `healer`) line ends -> heal_cradle_open at the eye (cradle SFX on frame 0)
heal_float_<N> (N = team size 1..6): all crystals rise together, ONE float SFX on frame 0 (never one per crystal)
heal_scanner_sweep once over the held heal_float_<N> last frame (scan SFX on frame 0)
heal_done_ping (done jingle on frame 0), then heal_float_<N> played backwards (crystals home), then party_seep_back over 2000 ms

cradle_centre.i_heal_machine_note: proposed: on the panel centre (measured panel bbox [26, 14, 101, 35]); the 128 px canvas is 2x2 tiles 7280-7283

hooks.world_design_note: Both machine arts (heal_machine_1_0 and i_heal_machine) still paint 6 round slots in a 2x3 grid (and i_heal_machine a row of 6 lights). That is the motif the IP check flagged. The overlay ignores them; World Design may want to repaint the slots as a plain counter/tray. World Design owns the final machine art.

party_crystal_glow.what: every party creature sprite/icon: crystal-mask pixels only (warmth/masks/<creature>/<same rel path>)
party_crystal_glow.company: draw the crystal pixels with Warmth stage 0 colours (the unswapped source ramp 3a1e60..f4e2ff)
party_crystal_glow.bright: fill crystal pixels with 'd6acff' (pixels that are 'f4e2ff' in the source stay 'f4e2ff')
party_crystal_glow.meaning: the company machine briefly re-asserts control: the light snaps back to company violet

party_seep_back.what: crystal pixels go from stage 0 back to the creature's CURRENT Warmth stage, ordered-dither, never a colour blend
party_seep_back.rule: at step s (1..8) a crystal pixel at sprite-local (x,y) shows the warm colour if BAYER[y%4][x%4] < 2*s, else stage 0. Key the pattern to sprite-local coordinates so it does not crawl when the sprite moves.
party_seep_back.stage0_creatures: stage 0 creatures: skip the seep (nothing to return to)

sfx: float (one cue for the whole team)
audio.jingle_rule: The done jingle must be ORIGINAL: write it from the Home motif with its own rhythm and contour. Audio must check it by ear against well-known heal tunes from other creature games before it ships.

hooks.interiors: heal centres are interiors: they stay on the DAY grade (club_int is the only interior on the clock). ToD strips grade them as outdoors anyway, as a worst case.
hooks.reduced_motion: skip heal_float_<N> motion: show its last frame directly; skip the sweep; glow as one 1000 ms bright hold; seep back in 4 steps of 500 ms
hooks.photosensitivity: no alternation anywhere; every lit state holds >= 167 ms; the glow is small (cradle + crystal pixels), not full-screen

open.rule: fraction of FX pixels with |dLuma|>=28 vs graded background under them, per phase; pass >= 0.5
